<thought>We need the number of distinct proton environments in the compound. The tool proton_nmr_spectra will return the 1H NMR spectrum for the target molecule (the SMILES is pre‑loaded in the environment). By examining the spectrum we can count how many separate signals (peaks) are reported, which corresponds to the number of chemically equivalent hydrogen types. We'll call the tool and then count the signals.</thought>
<action>proton_nmr_spectra</action>
